title: tc-testimonial-wall
description: The landing-page wall of quotes: columns that scroll endlessly in opposite directions, ease to a stop on hover and pause for good.

columns.description: Most columns on a wide container – narrower containers use fewer (2 below 740 px, 1 below 480 px)

speed.description: Pixels per second of the first column; the others run a little slower and faster

pauseOnHover.description: Ease a column to a stop while the pointer is over it or a card in it has keyboard focus

paused.description: Stopped for good (the Pause / Play button's state)

pauseButton.description: Show the Pause / Play button (on by default – moving content needs a way to stop it, WCAG 2.2.2)

buttonLabels.description: The Pause button's name, and the Play button's

quote.description: The quote itself – mix short and long ones, the masonry looks more natural

avatar.description: Photo URL; without one the initials sit on a soft gray circle

rating.description: 1–5 – a small, calm gray star row above the quote

verified.description: A small gray check beside the name
